card.name: Words leading into oseltamivir and influenza
card.fires_on: Words just before or inside oseltamivir and influenza mentions, such as 'with', 'of' or 'receiving' ahead of oseltamivir, or the start of 'Influenza'. It appears in oseltamivir label text and flu pandemic papers.

modes.label: Linking word before oseltamivir
modes.description: A small word like 'with' or 'receiving' right before the drug name oseltamivir phosphate.
modes.example: have been reported in postmarketing experience<< with>> oseltamivir phosphate for oral

modes.label: Inside oseltamivir name
modes.description: Partway through the drug name oseltamivir.
modes.example: The constituted oral suspension contains 360 mg of os<<elt>>amivir base per 60

modes.label: Before or inside influenza
modes.description: 'of' after prophylaxis, or the beginning pieces of the word Influenza.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of oseltamivir phosphate for oral suspension for prophylaxis<< of>> influenza in adults and adolescents 13
